overview: After 1.b3 f5 2.Bb2 e6 White plays 3.e4, offering the pawn. If Black takes with 3...fxe4 White plays Nc3, Qh5+ g6 and Bxg7 or Nxe4, gaining a lead in development. Black can also decline with ...Nf6. The idea is to pull Black's structure apart and open the diagonal for the b2 bishop.

white_ideas.idea: Open the long diagonal and attack with Nc3, Qh5+
Win back the pawn on e4 and develop quickly

black_ideas.idea: Take on e4 and hold the pawn with ...Nf6
Neutralise the queen check and develop

typical_structures.structure: Black weakened kingside around g7 and e6

character.notes: Sharp, with Black's king exposed and White sacrificing for activity.

gambit.notes: After 3...fxe4 White has not recaptured and Black can keep the pawn.

soundness.notes: A speculative gambit; Black can probably hold the extra pawn.

sublines_that_differ.name: 3...Nf6
sublines_that_differ.how: Declines and leads to a calmer line

character.reason: A pawn sacrifice with queen checks.

gambit.reason: White gives the e-pawn and Black can keep it.

soundness.reason: Black can probably hold the pawn.

plans.reason: White plays for the long diagonal and fast development.
